item.title: Insider: Flyers DID Want Carter Hart Back
item.description: We heard back in September from GM Danny Briere that goaltender Carter Hart would not be returning to the Philadelphia Flyers once he was eligible to return to the NHL as of this week. item.title: Insider: Canadiens Shopping For Goaltender
item.description: The Montreal Canadiens rank 30th in the NHL in goals against average, at 3.54 allowed per game. Similarly, they're 30th in save percentage, at .877. Sam Montembeault has been supremely disappointing this season, with a 5-6-1 mark, an .861 Sv% and a 3.61 goals against average. item.title: Insider: Dallas Stars To Be 'Even More Aggressive' On Trade Market
item.description: The Dallas Stars suffered a devastating blow this week as key veteran Tyler Seguin suffered a season-ending torn ACL. The two-way star forward had contributed 17 points and a plus/minus rating of +10 thus far to Dallas' terrific 18-5-5 start. He will be greatly missed.And to that end, the Stars are going to put their trade efforts into overdrive going forward, as noted on TSN's Insider Trading by Chris Johnston. I think where it leads them now is, they're likely to be even more aggressive buyers
